content_of_post_to_comment: I keep seeing a lot of people saying they don't trust Pangram because their work even from before AI gets flagged, and yet oddly I haven't seen anyone provide examples. I am sure it at least occasionally happens but the total lack of examples is curious.
comment: The absence of examples is interesting, but it may also reflect a documentation problem: false positives are hard to prove when the tool's criteria aren't transparent. The burden of evidence cuts both ways.
